properties.Description: Kellumtown is an unincorporated community located near Hubert, North Carolina. It consists of approximately one hundred acres of land that was owned by a man named Raymond M. Kellum. Upon the displacement of hundreds of families from the lower New River basin area, Kellum allowed many to live on his land until they could afford to purchase plots of it from him. The property became known as "Kellumtown" amongst the residents.
